name: John Guild
role: Backer of the Hay Creek coal road and De Mores townsite
bio: John Guild, described in May 1884 as of New York, was one of the company that laid out the townsite of De Mores at the junction of the Redwater and Belle Fourche. In June 1884 he and Gallop traveled from Medora to the Hills by chartered team, and in July the paper reported them planning a railroad from De Mores to the Hay Creek coal mines. In November 1885 the paper reported him at Spearfish as the backer of the Hay Creek coal road.
